exercises.name: Flat DB Press
exercises.cue: Shoulder blades back, lower to chest level, press up evenly.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.cue: Pull the bar to your upper chest, elbows down to your sides, no swinging.

exercises.name: Machine Shoulder Press
exercises.cue: Core braced, lower to chin height, press up without arching your back.

exercises.name: Seated Row
exercises.cue: Sit tall, pull the handle to your stomach, squeeze your shoulder blades together.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curls
exercises.cue: Elbows by your sides, curl up slowly, lower all the way.

cardio.name: Easy cardio - 10 min
cardio.detail: Bike, cross-trainer or incline walk, at a pace where you can still talk.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.cue: Feet shoulder-width on the platform, lower under control, stop short of locking out.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.cue: Weights close to your legs, push your hips back with a flat back, then stand tall.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.cue: Sit back in the seat, straighten your legs smoothly, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Hamstring Curl
exercises.cue: Hips down on the pad, curl smoothly, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Calf Raise
exercises.cue: Full stretch at the bottom, rise onto your toes, pause at the top.

cardio.name: Walk
cardio.detail: No gym today. An easy walk toward your step goal, and light stretching if you feel stiff.

exercises.name: Chest Press Machine
exercises.cue: Handles at chest height, press out smoothly, slow on the way back.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.cue: Chest on the pad, pull your elbows back, squeeze your shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.cue: Rope at face height, pull toward your forehead with elbows high, squeeze your upper back.

exercises.name: DB Lateral Raises
exercises.cue: Lead with your elbows, lift to shoulder height, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
exercises.cue: Elbows at your sides, push down to straight arms, control the way back.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.cue: Hold a dumbbell at your chest, sit down between your heels, stand up through your whole foot.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.cue: Upper back on a bench, drive through your heels, squeeze your glutes at the top.

exercises.name: Back Extension
exercises.cue: Hips on the pad, lower with a flat back, rise until your body is in a straight line.

exercises.name: Hamstring Curl
exercises.cue: Hips down on the pad, curl smoothly, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Calf Raise
exercises.cue: Full stretch at the bottom, rise onto your toes, pause at the top.
